prompt: A recipe box web app: add recipes with ingredients and steps, tag and search them, scale servings, a printable view, data saved in the browser, works on a phone, keyboard accessible; with tests.

org.sizing: Lean: a small web app with two real streams, so a frontend engineer builds the app, storage, search, scaling and the tests, and a UI designer owns the look, phone layout and print view, both reporting to me.

plan.goal: A recipe box web app: add recipes with ingredients and steps, tag and search them, scale servings, a printable view, data saved in the browser, works on a phone, keyboard accessible; with tests. Built as Vite + React + TypeScript, tested with Vitest and Testing Library, browser-only, in a warm cookbook look (light theme plus print).

tasks.title: Scaffold the project and test setup
Recipe types, storage, search and scaling logic
Recipe detail with serving scaling and print button
Search, tag filter and recipe list
App shell, saved data, routing and integration tests
Screen styles, phone layout and print view
Final review against the stakeholder's request
